item.description: Starboard Value CEO Jeff Smith this week laid out the activist fund’s approach to its three latest investments at the annual 13D Monitor Active-Passive Investor Summit in New York today. Bloomberg's Scarlet Fu reports on "Bloomberg Deals." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: EQT Nears €9.6 Billion Deal for Molecular Testing Firm Qiagen
item.description: EQT AB is nearing a deal to acquire Qiagen NV for around €9.6 billion ($10.8 billion) bringing an end to years of takeover speculation involving the European molecular testing company, according to people familiar with the matter.

item.title: Small Business Owners Remain Optimistic, Says Chase for Business CEO
item.description: Stevie Baron, CEO of Chase for Business, said that despite a difficult geoeconomic landscape, small business owners remain optimistic about their individual business and their potential for success across industries. Speaking from the Chase Make Your Move Summit in Atlanta, Baron said that Chase's aim is to support small business owners and do whatever it can as a bank to make owners financial lives easier. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Treasuries Slide After Middle East Strife Report Spurs Oil Gains
